provenance.purpose: Offline numerical and realtime-budget probe of naturally generated maximum-layer Plate descriptors.
provenance.input: long-run-evidence.json; first 12 frozen Plate descriptors for each of its three deterministic natural-run seeds.
provenance.worklet: static/worklets/surface-plate.worklet.js loaded directly into Node vm; no browser or audio-device path.
provenance.syntheticInput: 144 bounded QA foot-contact groups/s for 0.5s; 3 deterministic centerline points/group selected from frozen natural Plate descriptors; group strength 0.045. Energy is L2-distributed over the actual containing masks and is never replayed from recorded ANT contacts.
provenance.cpuProtocol: Warm 20 128-frame quanta, then time 400 consecutive 128-frame process calls on the 12 natural masks. Compare p50/p95/max to the exact 128/sampleRate quantum duration. Node VM timings are diagnostic only; they do not certify Chrome AudioWorklet realtime performance.
provenance.energyFormula: Per layer: 0.5*rho*sum((u[t]-u[t-1])^2) + 0.5*rho*b*sum(Lu[t]*Lu[t-1]) - 0.5*T*sum(u[t]*Lu[t-1]); per overlap cell pair: 0.5*k*(uA[t]-uB[t])*(uA[t-1]-uB[t-1]). L is the implemented four-neighbor graph Laplacian.
limitations: The worklet is executed in a Node vm with simulated AudioWorklet globals; this does not include Chrome scheduling, browser output routing, hardware, or actual real-time underruns.
Synthetic deterministic foot-like points and impulses verify bounded numerical behavior; they are not an ANT behavior replay, natural contact distribution, or listening assessment.
CPU quantiles are machine- and load-dependent and should be interpreted as a local measurement.
